purpose: Prove durable paid-but-unshipped cancellation across exact Order, Payment, Fulfillment, Inventory reservation, and one shared cancellation Saga.
environment_policy: local, demo, or disposable test tenant only; start-only recovery drill is local/test only
credentials: environment variables only; never command arguments, scenario files, or ledgers
flow: create and publish one governed Listing offer
place Order from the exact published offer
reserve 2 units and bind the exact reservation to the Order item
capture 39800 CNY minor units through INTERNAL_TEST and confirm Order payment
create one complete Fulfillment in CREATED without Shipment
submit one Saga START with cancellationMode PAID_UNSHIPPED and exact orderId; the backend derives and validates the Order-owned paymentId and Fulfillment
START atomically fences Order and Fulfillment before the worker can refund or release
poll the read-only Saga route until COMPLETED or fail closed on MANUAL_REVIEW/timeout
prove Fulfillment request/finalize, Payment refund, Inventory release, and Order finalize replay as immutable duplicates
replay all 14 client-issued commands, including the identical START, as immutable duplicates
invariants: Saga START contains cancellationMode PAID_UNSHIPPED and orderId, contains no client-supplied paymentId/fulfillmentId, and contains no fault-injection field
Order and Fulfillment cancellation fences are durable before asynchronous compensation starts
Fulfillment is cancelled before Payment refund, Inventory release, and Order finalization
Payment is fully refunded exactly once and captured_amount_minor equals refunded_amount_minor
the exact TRADE_ORDER reservation is released once and terminal available stock returns to 10
Fulfillment never owns a Shipment, carrier, waybill, or tracking event
Saga COMPLETED requires one cancelled Fulfillment, one refunded Payment, and every reservation RELEASED
the same START payload returns its immutable REQUESTED/v1 result when replayed

restart_recovery.start_command: run with --completion-mode start-only while the normal worker is disabled
restart_recovery.paused_expected: Saga REQUESTED/v1 with Order and Fulfillment fences already durable
restart_recovery.resume_command: restart with the worker enabled and rerun the same run_id using --completion-mode wait
restart_recovery.resume_expected: all setup commands and START replay as duplicate; worker resumes to COMPLETED/v9

fault_injection: not exposed by this runner; deterministic backend failure injection belongs only to test scope
cleanup: refund, Fulfillment cancellation, reservation release, and Order cancellation are the compensation; retain immutable audit evidence
